boundary.isolation: Separate temporary configuration, workspaces and WebView2 profiles; native UI uses the real Wails entry points. The existing local key is inherited ephemerally, never copied into the secret store.

findingsAndFixes: Initial model streaming had no crash checkpoint until four tool calls. Commit the original run/contract and checkpoint before the first model request, after model/tool batches and before effectful execution.
Persist hashed effect intent before execution. Unknown or previously effectful recovery is review-required; never silently replay a write or recapture its append prefix.

Take an OS-released native data-owner lock before opening SQLite. Reconcile prior running records as interrupted without starting models/tools. Safe explicit resume creates a linked generation from the original sealed contract.

Retain agent ownership through autosave and terminal persistence; cancel and join on native shutdown. Atomically replace session files; terminal TaskRun/checkpoint retirement shares one SQLite transaction.
Workspace changes cleared the UI but retained the prior backend conversation name. Clear it in both workspace paths; checkpoint recovery uses a collision-safe saved-chat fork.

A 1024-token no-thinking cap and 2048-token direct cap truncated long messages, and the truncation flag could be discarded. Reasoning depth no longer limits answer length. Long text uses up to 8192 context-aware tokens and at most three tool-free continuations, retaining one assembled answer.
User cancellation, output limits and errors retain visible partial text and saved delivery metadata. Limits/no progress are not completion; file/action tasks retain verification gates.

The filename append-fixture.txt triggered live sports-fact routing and removed read tools. Exclude named file paths from live-fact keyword matching while retaining genuine surrounding live-data intent.
Windows PTY startup resolved a relative shell under Cmd.Dir. Resolve the executable first; remove the dependency's racing CommandContext waiter and retain one explicit process owner.
Wrap the complete review-required recovery explanation in the native dialog rather than hiding its meaning behind an ellipsis.

nativeObservations.detail: Real Stop retained partial output with Stopped by you; New chat/reopen preserved that outcome; a fresh same-chat exact reply completed. Active New chat/workspace changes were refused while Stop remained available.

Native workspace selector, B reply and autosave retained separate A/B chats. Original A bytes stayed unchanged after B actually saved; both backend switching paths also pass five repeated regressions.

Killed and joined only the exact owned test PID/start time during text generation. Startup marked it interrupted with no new work. Native Checkpoints Resume created an explicitly linked run and Recovered-* chat; it did not overwrite the source transcript.

A bounded watcher observed the exact disposable suffix, then revalidated/killed/joined the owned native process. Restart retained the same bytes and run count, marked interruption, and disabled unsafe Resume with the complete readable warning. No write was replayed.

Exact native request Read append-fixture.txt and show its exact contents. Use file tools only. Do not modify any file. completed with one real read, complete control state and unchanged single-append SHA-256.

Real native UI request generated and saved its finished ending without an output-limit stop. Forced-cut continuation, repetition limits and exact history assembly are separately covered by deterministic model fixtures, not misreported as forced-cut live-model qualification.

Observed a live partial stream and enabled Stop, then Alt+F4 closed the test app. Exact owned process exited; no Mauler windows remained. Saved run is stopped/application_shutdown, control cancelled, partial output retained and recovery checkpoints retained.

diagnosticsRetained: The original baseline app had five runs and zero checkpoints after a hard kill; see evidence-baseline/baseline-after-hard-crash.json. Its long answer hit 1024 tokens and was incorrectly accepted as complete.

The initial isolated A/B test found a genuine saved-chat overwrite. Only disposable fixture data was affected; the fresh repaired A/B test above qualifies the fix, not recovery of any historically overwritten user chat.
evidence-final/after-native-post-crash-read.json is the failed filename-routing diagnostic. after-fixed-native-post-crash-read.json is the repaired exact-wording result.

evidence-final/after-active-native-close.json was an earlier late close observation whose output had already hit its limit. It is not active-close acceptance; after-confirmed-active-close.json is the actual active-stream shutdown result.

race.log retains the go-pty context-waiter data race. race-focused-after.log and race-final.log pass after using one process waiter. A test-only double-close of ConPTY was corrected separately; it was not counted as a product failure.

Initial long-answer test fixtures used an 8K context with insufficient prompt/output headroom. They now use the actual qualified 35K context. Exhausted real context fails visibly rather than overfilling the backend.

freshLocalRegression.detail: Fresh current-source chat/read/write/append/cancel/recover matrix after the native fixes. The earlier separate 65/65 result remains historical, not a claim that this native matrix ran five times.

remaining: No physical reboot, power loss, torn-storage or cross-file/SQLite crash-atomicity qualification was performed.
Shell/PTY descendant containment, persistent PTY recovery, browser/MCP/remote/channel crash journeys and Unix native behavior remain unqualified.
Partial streaming is not checkpointed per token; safe text recovery may regenerate text. Unknown effects deliberately require explicit review/new scoped work, not unattended replay.
Continuation has finite context, time and three-continuation limits; these are honest stops, not a guarantee that every arbitrary-length or semantic task finishes correctly.

Fresh full 12/12 UI Gate 1 followed by complete Agent Eval x5 remains required for the broader unattended reliability milestone. No fresh dependency/security audit or blanket industry-standard claim is made.
